notes: Pre-trained baseline models. AIY Food V1 for binary gate + classify (no custom training). YOLO26n COCO FP16 for detection. Food-101 MobileNetV1 0.5x int8 as fallback classifier when AIY V1 confidence < 60%. NMS is performed in JavaScript, not baked into models.

models.name: AIY Food V1 (Binary Gate)
models.description: Google AIY Food V1 model repurposed as binary gate. Max confidence across 2024 food classes > threshold = food detected.

models.name: YOLO26n COCO Detection
models.description: YOLO26n pre-trained on COCO. 80 classes including 10 food items. NMS performed in JavaScript.

models.name: AIY Food V1 (Classification)
models.description: Google AIY Food V1 model for 2024-class food classification.

models.name: Food-101 MobileNetV1 0.5x (Fallback)
models.description: STMicroelectronics MobileNetV1 alpha=0.5 trained on Food-101 (101 classes, 80.64% top-1 accuracy). Used as fallback when AIY Food V1 confidence < 60%. Int8 quantized, ~1MB.
